question.question: Which of the following are essential components of a CI/CD pipeline for machine learning models?

options.text: Automated testing of model performance on a validation set
Versioning of data and model artifacts
Automated retraining on new data without validation

question.explanation: A robust ML CI/CD pipeline requires automated validation of model performance (opt1) and versioning of data, code, and model artifacts (opt3) to ensure reproducibility and traceability. Manual deployment (opt2) contradicts the goal of automation, and retraining without validation (opt4) risks deploying degraded models.
